description: Both behavioral-spec.md (REQ-002 Acceptance Criteria) and verification-architecture.md (Tier 1 strategy) justify the ENTIRE test methodology for sol-trade's real-money ledger wiring (PROP-005 through PROP-008, i.e. all of REQ-002's verification) by citing a precedent: 'mirroring/following the exact "fake CLI first in $PATH" pattern already proven working in skills/earn/clip-promote/tests/test_run.sh (a stub franklin-trading script that prints canned balance/start output ...)'. I read the complete, real content of /Users/operator/anicca/skills/earn/clip-promote/tests/test_run.sh: it contains NO such pattern. Its actual techniques are (1) a direct 'bash run.sh' discover-mode smoke test, (2) a timeout/gtimeout watchdog-primitive check, (3) a direct record.mjs call plus 'env -i' PII-scrub test (GOOGLE_LOGIN THROWS vs. env -i strips it and records), and (4) a LOCAL HTTP RPC stub server (tests/fake_solana_rpc.mjs, bound to a random port, wired in via the SOLANA_RPC_URL env override) for the record-e2e test. There is no stub binary ever placed first on $PATH anywhere in this file or anywhere else I could find under skills/ (searched for PATH-prepend / mkdir bin / chmod +x bin patterns repo-wide). The cited precedent is fabricated/hallucinated. Since PROP-005 through PROP-008 anchor their entire feasibility on 'mirroring' a pattern that does not exist, phase-2 test authors have no real, previously-vetted technique to copy for stubbing the external franklin-trading CLI's stdout. The real, ACTUALLY-proven precedent in this same file -- a local HTTP stub for the RPC layer -- is arguably the better fit here too, since sigStatus/usdcDeltaForSig already accept an injectable fetchImpl/rpc url (solana-verify.mjs) exactly like fake_solana_rpc.mjs already exploits for clip-promote; only extractLastSignature's own stdout-parsing (PROP-010) and the run.sh glue (PROP-005/006) need any CLI-output stand-in, and the spec should describe precisely how that stand-in works instead of pointing at a pattern that isn't there.

evidence.snippet: "following the exact 'fake CLI first in $PATH' pattern already proven working in skills/earn/clip-promote/tests/test_run.sh (a stub franklin-trading script that prints canned balance/start output, so no mainnet call or real money is ever touched by a test)"

Full file read: uses timeout/gtimeout, direct record.mjs + env -i PII tests, and tests/fake_solana_rpc.mjs (an HTTP RPC stub server) -- no PATH-prepended fake CLI binary anywhere.
